visual_world: A single green-eyed, dark-haired traveler moves through an invented mountain-to-sea borderland. Lanterns, wet roads, red woven thread, fire, family photographs and a medallion recur as inheritance motifs. The palette migrates from blue-black night and amber practicals toward sunrise gold.
